title: Privacy Policy
content:
## Privacy Policy

At **ScholarBridge**, accessible from https://scholarbridge.org, one of our main priorities is the privacy of our visitors. This Privacy Policy document contains types of information that is collected and recorded by ScholarBridge and how we use it.

### 1. Information We Collect
We only collect information about you if we have a reason to do so—for example, to provide our scholarship deadline alert services, to communicate with you, or to make our directory better.

### 2. Log Files
ScholarBridge follows a standard procedure of using log files. These files log visitors when they visit websites. The information collected includes IP addresses, browser type, Internet Service Provider (ISP), date and time stamp, referring/exit pages, and number of clicks.

### 3. Cookies and Web Beacons
Like any other website, ScholarBridge uses 'cookies'. These cookies are used to store information including visitors' preferences, and the pages on the website that the visitor accessed or visited.

### 4. Contact Us
If you have additional questions or require more information about our Privacy Policy, do not hesitate to contact us at privacy@scholarbridge.org.
seoDescription: Learn how ScholarBridge protects your personal data and privacy when using our international scholarship portal.

title: Terms and Conditions
content:
## Terms of Service

Welcome to **ScholarBridge**! These terms and conditions outline the rules and regulations for the use of ScholarBridge's Website, located at https://scholarbridge.org.

### 1. Acceptance of Terms
By accessing this website we assume you accept these terms and conditions. Do not continue to use ScholarBridge if you do not agree to take all of the terms and conditions stated on this page.

### 2. Information Accuracy & Disclaimer
All scholarship listings, deadlines, funding amounts, and criteria are published for educational informational purposes only. While we verify all sources directly with sponsoring universities and governments, applicants must always verify final details with the official sponsor website.

### 3. User Conduct
You must not use this website in any way that causes, or may cause, damage to the website or impairment of the availability or accessibility of ScholarBridge.

### 4. Governing Law
These Terms shall be governed and construed in accordance with the laws of international open educational repositories.

title: Disclaimer
content:
## Legal Disclaimer

### Independent Directory
ScholarBridge is an independent global educational portal. ScholarBridge is **NOT** a direct funding agency and does **NOT** charge any fees to search for or apply to scholarships.

### Official Application Verification
All scholarship applications must be submitted directly through the respective sponsoring university, government portal, or foundation official application links provided on each detail page.

### No Guarantee of Award
ScholarBridge provides advisory resources, formatting guides, and deadline trackers. We do not guarantee admission or scholarship award decisions, which remain solely at the discretion of the scholarship sponsors.
seoDescription: Important legal disclaimer regarding independent scholarship listings, verification, and non-affiliation.

title: Cookie Policy
content:
## Cookie Policy

### What Are Cookies?
Cookies are small text files that are placed on your computer or mobile device when you browse websites.

### How We Use Cookies
We use cookies to remember your bookmarks, language preferences, and filter settings, as well as to analyze our website traffic through privacy-preserving analytics.

### Managing Cookies
You can control and/or delete cookies as you wish through your browser settings.
